management_steps.details: DKA: HGT > 11 (or known DM), younger, ketones positive, blood gas metabolic acidosis, anion gap > 16. HHS: HGT > 30, elderly, ketones absent/weak, minimal acidosis, serum osmolarity > 350, altered mental status.

ABCD. Large bore IV. Fluid resuscitation with Ringer's/Balsol: DKA (150-200ml/hr for 1st 4 hours), HHS (cautious, slower rate 100-200ml/hr). If shocked, give 20ml/kg bolus. When HGT < 15: change fluid to 5% Dextrose in Ringer's/Balsol.
Delay insulin if Potassium < 3.5! Add 20-40 mmol/L KCl to IV fluids to maintain K of 4-5. Add MgSO4 2g to maintenance fluids if low.
Give Actrapid 0.1 u/kg IV stat (max 10 u) followed by Actrapid infusion at 0.1 u/kg/hr. Perform hourly HGT monitoring.
